description: NXP FRDM-IMX91S target provisioned from a product-owned UUU script and component artifacts, then verified over the board's USB-C debug UART.

backendNotes.target: The selected UUU command executes the Product-owned .lst script. deploy.image contains exactly one script; its relative pub/ files are supplied as deploy.uuu component artifacts. Set workspace.target.serial to the first CH343 USB-UART device when serialVerify is enabled.
backendNotes.download: Put SW1 into Serial Downloader mode and connect the board USB OTG/download port. The USB-C debug UART is a separate console connection.
